[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/3″ el_class=”choose-box”][vc_single_image image=”29″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center”][vc_custom_heading text=”COMPETENT” font_container=”tag:h4|text_align:center” use_theme_fonts=”yes”][vc_column_text]

We employ engineers with incredible integration of hands-on OEM training and a recognized PRINCE 2 project management experience that enables them to proficiently ramp down OEM magnets and handle customers’ requirements competently and successfully.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/3″ el_class=”choose-box”][vc_single_image image=”30″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center”][vc_custom_heading text=”CLIENT-ORIENTED” font_container=”tag:h4|text_align:center” use_theme_fonts=”yes”][vc_column_text]

Carefully understanding the client’s needs and the restraints encountered enables us to provide an accurate scope of technical services and Project management, coupled with Quality Assurance (QA) audit, logistical management, patient data deletion, and Portable Appliance Testing (PAT).

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/3″ el_class=”choose-box”][vc_single_image image=”31″ img_size=”full” alignment=”center”][vc_custom_heading text=”TIMELY & BUDGET FRIENDLY” font_container=”tag:h4|text_align:center” use_theme_fonts=”yes”][vc_column_text]

Our expert engineers hold the expertise that enables them to perform successful project execution and problem-solving strategies without any additional support, which allows for timely and budget-friendly project completion. Depending on the client’s specifications and requirements, we can offer these services independently, in combination, or as a whole process.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column css=”.vc_custom_1606745245854{padding-top: 40px !important;}”][vc_column_text]

Please contact us for more information or to receive a follow up request

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1549014128490{margin-top: 100px !important;}” el_class=”about-sec”][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_custom_heading text=”Goring Medical Projects Ltd” use_theme_fonts=”yes”][vc_custom_heading text=”Projects Managed With Precision and Accuracy” font_container=”tag:h3|text_align:left” use_theme_fonts=”yes”][vc_column_text]Goring Medical Projects Limited has been established with the aim to provide technical support and Project management to the public and private healthcare sector, particularly hospitals, medical centers, equipment brokers and resellers. We conduct our professional operations to provide Project Management and technical solutions of diagnostic imaging equipment in healthcare environments, to provide our clients with the most reliable and flexible service in the industry.

We extend our technical services to the healthcare sector by embracing a broad spectrum of Project Management and Medical Engineering that includes system installation, de-installation, relocation, ramp down, inspection, system evaluation, mobile/relocatable and modular design. Our extensive range of technical medical support services expands to every business dealing with the healthcare sector, from Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM’s), equipment brokers and resellers, hospital radiology and procurement managers, to hospitals estate managers and third party diagnostic imaging equipment providers.

Accurate and competent, ramp down, relocation and maintenance of diagnostic medical equipment used in medical centers or hospitals is a matter of great concern and thus, requires complete expert handling. We understand that the Radiology departments depends not only on the quality of treatment and health care provided, but also greatly on the correct running and efficiencies of the medical equipment.

Goring Medical employ OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturers) engineers who are highly trained to handle the technicalities of all the medical equipment with industry recognized PRINCE 2 project management experience. Hence, possessing a vast technical knowledge and applied experience in Project Management of diagnostic imaging equipment in hospitals, we ensure to provide our clients with a highly standardized and quality assured services.

Being professionally committed to deliver excellence, we hold ourselves responsible for inspecting and managing the ramp down of diagnostic machines, de-installation, installation, and relocation of medical equipment, ensuring that the breakdown of the equipment and accidents made during diagnosis and treatment can be avoided and eliminated altogether. Our high-quality audits help you, our valued client, to achieve the highest possible value for your equipment.

Nevertheless, we are able to live by our professional commitments due to the focused support of our expert engineers who possess technical OEM equipment training combined with PRINCE 2 certified Project Management that enables them to handle customers’ requirements competently, carefully and cost-effectively. Additionally, this means our resources, that is the Engineer/project manager, is sufficiently trained to complete all the technical tasks as opposed to requiring numerous staff members on board for the project. Consequently, we can save time, cost and extra hassle for our clients.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_single_image image=”625″ img_size=”full” css=”.vc_custom_1604548737672{margin-top: 0px !important;margin-bottom: 0px !important;border-top-width: 0px !important;border-bottom-width: 0px !important;padding-top: 0px !important;padding-bottom: 0px !important;}”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width=”stretch_row” el_class=”makes-section” css=”.vc_custom_1582637486551{background-image: url(https://goringmedicalprojects.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/what-makes-us-different-1250×560.jpg?id=149) !important;}”][vc_column width=”1/2″][vc_custom_heading text=”What makes us different?” use_theme_fonts=”yes”][vc_column_text el_class=”makes-diff”]

  • A proven track record within the industry.
  • Emergency on-site diagnosis and repair (Ad-Hoc).
  • Detailed QA and audit reports with OEM knowledge of the systems.
  • Unrivaled attention to detail and customer service.
  • Cost efficiency coupled with exceptional support.
  • Multi-modality, Multi-OEM capability, and tool inventory.
  • A large rigging inventory available for rental.
  • Certified training in engineering, project management, and health and safety.
  • Ramp down of GE, Siemens, Canon, and Philips MRI within 24 hours.

First, must say that we were very fortunate to find company and people so dedicated and professional. As a start-up company with a vision in providing the best radiology diagnostics and healthcare, we are so happy that we chose Goring Medical Projects Ltd for powering up our Siemens Symphony TIM 1.5T MRI system. We are sure that our cooperation will not end there and we will continue to rely on Goring Medical Projects Ltd moving forwards. I would also like to take the opportunity to thank Wayne Goring for being so kind and helpful and for setting new standards in professionalism. His knowledge of MRI systems is outstanding and without precedent! thank you once again and wish you all the best!

ALEKSANDAR MUSTAFU OWNER

After several projects together, we’re very pleased with the technical expertise of Goring Medical Projects and appreciate their professional efficiency. They make things simple – offering great trouble-shooting and clever recommendations that help us cut costs and do things in smarter ways. The MRI team solved problems before we even knew they existed (and certainly before they became greater concerns).

This team has our back! I have trust in Goring Medical Projects Ltd that I have for no other EU/UK service provider—all around an impressive and engaged group. I’m regularly looking for ways to involve Goring Medical Projects Ltd more and more in our projects.

BRIAN VON GUNTEN – VP EUROPEAN OPERATIONS BLOCK IMAGING - HOLT - MICHIGAN - UNITED STATES

In a very short timescale, Goring Medical Projects worked together to provide us with excellent technical advice and comprehensive and professional project management services. They have provided excellent customer service, equipment and value in a very short timescale and I look forward to working with them again for future requirements.

COREY FRAZER IMAGING MANAGER

I am emailing you to let you know how happy I am with your service. Starting with Wayne who stayed in contact throughout the process updating me, he has received several phone calls from me asking questions and has always been contactable. Your team are so professional and knowledgeable. Wayne was always on-hand and helpful throughout. His hands on training let me understand a lot more about the service we now can offer with the help of work by Wayne and his team. Lastly, you worked professionally, considerately, with excellent knowledge. I could not recommend the service received any higher.

Joe Piconas Managing Director
